title: Mark the boundary between two clauses
instructions: Choose the words and punctuation that correctly complete the sentence.

parts.prompt: The science club tested the filter ______ was clearer.

choice_rationales.A: A comma alone still joins two complete clauses without a conjunction.
choice_rationales.B: A semicolon correctly separates two closely related complete clauses.
choice_rationales.C: Although makes the second group dependent, and the full stop leaves it as a fragment.
choice_rationales.D: With no punctuation or conjunction, the two complete clauses run together.

parts.hint: Both sides can stand alone as sentences. Choose a boundary that can separate two complete clauses.
parts.correct_explanation: The semicolon creates a correct boundary between two closely related complete clauses.
